scope: Rename only one bound local identity in an owned Workflow or CronWorkflow document, including all exact declarations and static references. Foreign YAML documents and unrelated same-scope files retain every byte.
task: Rename DAG declaration, dependency or depends operands, DAG target and simple/expression references together. A step rename changes its own declaration and references in later groups and template outputs.
parametersArtifacts: Input names bind local call argument keys and same-template inputs references. Output names bind own output path references and all resolved local caller task/step outputs. Workflow parameter names bind workflow.parameters references without renaming unrelated same-name inputs.
positions: Support exact plain or quoted identifiers, simple tags, constant string-index expression tags, raw valueFrom.expression/fromExpression, Unicode before references and CRLF. Preserve quotes, surrounding expression syntax and every unrelated byte. Raw valueFrom.parameter and artifact from dotted variables are included. Simple tags do not accept expression indexing. Expression string literals remain unchanged; a new non-identifier member uses a constant string index.
refusal: Reject conflicting or duplicate names, public resources, aliases/merges, unknown member access, external or inherited template calls, exported global output identity, and incomplete effective scopes. Computed input/output keys affect only their template and category; computed task/step keys affect that owner and its callees outputs. Unrelated workflow.uid and independent-template dynamic inputs do not block task rename. Coupled workflow-argument and entrypoint-input declarations are refused.
versions: Return only versioned documentChanges for the current open buffer. Undo restores original diagnostics and bytes; an older didChange version is ignored, and new unresolved state cannot reuse a former binding.
upstream: Argo Workflows v3.6.0 commit b26ed4aa4dee395844531efa4a76a022183bec22: docs/variables.md, docs/conditional-artifacts-parameters.md, docs/enhanced-depends-logic.md, workflow/validate/validate.go. No full historical semantic acceptance is inferred.
hookScope: A step lifecycle hook may reference its own step status as well as previous steps. Both declaration and hook reference initiate the same exact rename; other fields do not gain self visibility.
expressionSyntax: Expression tags and raw expression fields must parse under the pinned Argo 3.6.0 Expr v1.16.9 grammar without evaluating them. Incomplete operators or parentheses refuse prepare/rename even when a member prefix is recognizable. Escaped and raw string literals and comments retain every byte. A non-BMP character inside the expression before a real access must not shift its edit or UTF-16 position. Let bindings shadow namespace identifiers only in the declaration body, not in their initializers; unrelated local variables do not prevent rename. Diagnostics and edit simulation share the same parsed reference identities.
environmentAccess: Expr $env refers to the external environment even under a local let binding. Static namespace access conservatively refuses rename of potentially affected symbols in that namespace. Dynamic or whole-environment access, including get or aliases, blocks all accessible namespace sets. Unrelated namespaces and literal text remain usable and byte-identical.
